entities.summary: Udoka Timothy Azubuike is a Nigerian-American professional basketball player for Ironi Ness Ziona of the Israeli Ligat HaAl. He played college basketball for the Kansas Jayhawks and was selected in the first round of the 2020 NBA draft by the Utah Jazz.
